about: Sale-readiness evidence for one exact archive. Read by python -m release.sale_gate. Seeded 2026-09-18 from the rc3-era rows with nothing marked PASS; the lead maintainer fills status, archive_sha256, evidence and depends_on (each file with its sha256).

rows.requirement: Archive shape, withheld paths and runtime dependency closure of the exact archive (release.audit_archive on a fresh extraction into a path with a space and an accent)
rows.scope: package test on the frozen archive
rows.note: rc3 passed 98/0 on bd330827; no rc4 archive has been audited.

rows.requirement: No teacher-derived or third-party-creator doctrine, names, IDs or taglines ship (content provenance, not just names)
rows.note: Creator-derived styles and studies still ship (rc3 independent review blocker 1); needs re-authoring or an owner decision.

rows.requirement: Packaged Director and reference libraries are original, with provenance rationale a person has checked
rows.note: rc3 reviewer flagged reused case IDs and the 'not adapted' wording for a person's check.

rows.requirement: Every shipped font, model, media file, GSAP and the adapted HyperFrames runtime carry their component-specific licence and notices
rows.note: YuNet cleared in rc3; the full inventory has not been redone for rc4.

rows.requirement: A person has listened to the shipped music bed
rows.note: Measured clean in rc3, never heard.

rows.requirement: Two builds of the release commit produce identical SHA256SUMS
rows.note: Run release.build_package twice into fresh folders and compare.

rows.requirement: Source suites (tsc, lint, build, npm test stages, Python selftest) pass on the release commit, failures classified by runtime reachability
rows.note: rc3 figures are for 15dac37/3744f6a only.

rows.requirement: In-package test suite for shipped features passes inside an installed package with the install's own settings
rows.note: rc3 had 13 package failures including a production observer input (F4).

rows.requirement: Install from the downloaded ZIP on a clean supported Mac with Finder's PATH, including download/quarantine/opening and the documented prerequisites
rows.note: Needs a clean Mac (owner input R).

rows.requirement: Build and launch: start/stop/restart from Finder PATH, occupied and overridden ports, foreign PIDs never signalled
One provider choice drives the editor window, app, doctor and every edit (no CLI/provider/brain/model mismatch)
Doctor admits the selected provider through production admission after a sign-in made with Sniper's own wrapper, for Codex and for Claude
rows.note: Needs the owner's interactive sign-in through install/sign-in.command for each provider.

rows.requirement: Speech model hash-verified and local transcription works through the product path
Every install step (npm app, npm motion, venv, browser, model, CLIs, runtime, app build) repairs itself on rerun after interruption, partial download or corruption
Prerequisites are checked with exact next steps; downloads are hash-verified (pip lock, CLI lock, browser SHA-256, model SHA-256); Node floor derived from the lockfiles

Lifecycle: move/copy, rollback between release folders, cancellation, cache cleaning, uninstall that reports failures truthfully and keeps user settings/recovery data; global Codex/Claude state unchanged
Installer, provider switch, uninstall, cache cleaning and runtime construction are mutually exclusive with each other, the doctor and active edits/renders
The doctor's 'media admission (real sample)' check passes on the buyer's Mac through the qualified admission path
rows.note: Depends on the native admission workstream (native_admission_selftest.py) and the sandbox decision.

rows.requirement: A complete real edit through the Codex subscription route, primary agent route and advertised UI route
rows.note: Blocked by media admission and provider access.

rows.requirement: A complete real edit through the Claude subscription route, primary agent route and advertised UI route
rows.note: Blocked by media admission and the Claude sign-in.

rows.requirement: Long-form job: trim-only and produced treatments, captions, graphics, reference guidance, audio, enabled music; a revision and re-export
Shorts job: trim-only and produced treatments, captions, graphics, reference guidance, audio, enabled music; a revision and re-export
Full encoded outputs played with sound, speech/content fidelity and visible defects reviewed; matching editable project opened in live Studio
Segmenter and Clipper AI calls run through the selected subscription adapter; paid features separately gated and opt-in; no silent paid fallback
rows.note: Segmenter/Clipper still instantiate the paid SDK on the Claude route (other workstream).

rows.requirement: The stated privacy boundary is enforced in code (rendered critics' file access, trim-only review, downloads/cookies/captures disclosed)
rows.note: rc3 finding F7.

rows.requirement: Manual, agent instructions (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, both skill trees, overrides) and in-app text match the code for both providers
An outside operator follows only the shipped manual on a clean Mac with their own account and footage
rows.note: Needs a person and a clean Mac (owner input).

rows.requirement: Authenticated delivery of the exact bytes, with documented recovery/rollback
rows.note: No delivery channel has been exercised.

rows.requirement: Final licence wording reviewed; refund effect and governing law settled; client-project delivery clarified
rows.note: Owner input D.

rows.requirement: A real support route and response commitment are published
rows.note: Owner input D.

rows.requirement: GSAP's visual-builder restriction determined for this product from the publisher's terms or clarification
rows.note: rc3 finding F9.

rows.requirement: A fresh independent review of the final archive and report after the last change, with substantive findings fixed and re-reviewed
